Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.
The LORD appeared to us in the past, saying: I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have drawn you with loving devotion.
For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.
They replied, “Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved, you and your household.”
Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
Then Jesus came to them and said, All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.
For the foolishness of God is wiser than man’s wisdom, and the weakness of God is stronger than man’s strength.
Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the LORD.
And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah…
But Peter and the other apostles replied, We must obey God rather than men.
I know that You can do all things and that no plan of Yours can be thwarted.
Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise Him, my father’s God, and I will exalt Him.
The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.
For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort…
Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ…
I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.
The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has promised, among the remnant called by the LORD.
Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
How much better to acquire wisdom than gold! To gain understanding is more desirable than silver.
The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
“Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”
Wisdom is supreme; so acquire wisdom. And whatever you may acquire, gain understanding.
Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
For I take no pleasure in anyone’s death, declares the Lord GOD. So repent and live!
Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind. Does He speak and not act? Does He promise and not fulfill?

longest.text: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that you might understand that man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.
